name: LA-04
label: Safe R

key_factors: Mike Johnson, the Speaker of the House, holds a heavily Republican district (R+17) and is running for reelection
Johnson has raised over $20 million with $9.6 million on hand, dwarfing Democrat Matt Gromlich's $269,000
Prediction markets price Johnson at roughly 94% to win
No public general-election polling exists, but no expert raters flag the race as competitive
model.rationale: The district's strong Republican lean, Johnson's status as Speaker with a massive fundraising advantage, and markets pricing him near 94% all point to a comfortable incumbent win. The challenger's minimal cash on hand leaves no realistic path to close the gap.
model.watch: A major national political shift or an unexpected scandal could narrow the margin, though the structural Republican advantage in this district would likely still hold.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northwest Louisiana's fourth district is solidly Republican territory, and it is represented by Mike Johnson, who now serves as Speaker of the House. Johnson is running for reelection with an enormous financial edge, having raised more than $20 million and holding $9.6 million on hand. His Democratic opponent, Matt Gromlich, has raised under $270,000 with little cash remaining.

Prediction markets give Johnson roughly a 94 percent chance of winning, and no expert raters classify the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's strong partisan lean, the incumbency advantage, and the lopsided resource gap, all of which point to a safe Republican hold.
